strategyComparison.winRateDefinition: TP1 reached and not subsequently stopped; TP1 followed by a stop is excluded from wins and reported separately as stopped_after_tp1.
strategyComparison.realizedRNote: Average realized R includes only unambiguous TP2 (+3R) and full stop-loss (-1R) outcomes. stopped_after_tp1 is excluded until a partial-exit rule is explicitly defined.
strategyComparison.sourceNote: Historical backfill evaluates previously completed candles. Forward shadow signals are evaluated as new M15 candles close. These are analytical signals, not executed demo trades.

R_10.note: Only continuous segments with at least 400 M15 candles are evaluated. Discovery uses the first 50%; the later 50% is held out for validation. Entry is next candle open. Shared exits: 1.5 ATR stop, TP1=2R, TP2=3R, 96-candle horizon. Same-candle stop/target touches are ambiguous. A candidate is shown in validation only after at least 10 resolved validation signals. Expired trades are reported, not counted as wins or losses. This is exploratory research, not a live strategy.
